# Battleroar

Battleroar is a Greek epic metal band. They have released six studio albums.
After releasing Age of Chaos on Black Lotus Records, the band signed with .
Discography
*Battleroar (2003)
*Age of Chaos (2005)
*To Death and Beyond... (2008)
*Blood of Legends (2014)
*Codex Epicus (2018)
*Petrichor (2026)
